titles.title: Yellow Cactus w. Indian Paintbrush

description: Three yellow cactus flowers with pale yellow and green centers fill the composition. A bright red Indian paintbrush plant pokes into the image from the lower left corner. The vibrant blooms are set against a plain gray background.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
